reason: The plugin adds an agent permission mode that evaluates sandbox escalation requests, automatically approves selected low-risk actions, delegates ambiguous cases to users or an optional LLM, and rejects configured destructive operations.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加自动审查权限模式，根据操作风险自动放行、转交人工确认或拒绝沙箱提权请求。
summaries.en: Adds an auto-review permission mode for DeepSeek Harness that approves selected low-risk sandbox escalations, routes ambiguous requests for confirmation, and rejects configured destructive actions.

capabilities: Automatically grants one-time approval for selected low-risk operations
Routes ambiguous requests to human confirmation or an optional LLM review
Rejects configured destructive or blocked operations
Adds an auto-review permission preset and related UI icon
